meta.title: Forest Friends of Doupátkov
meta.description: A calm, gentle animated series for preschoolers. 80 short episodes about Ouško the little rabbit and his friends from a village inside an old oak tree.
meta.ogDescription: A calm, gentle animated series for preschoolers. 80 short episodes from a little village inside an old oak tree.

hero.alt: Ouško the rabbit, Brumla the bear cub, Babča Ježka the hedgehog and Notička the cricket in a meadow by the old oak
hero.lead: Calm stories from a little village inside an old oak tree. No scares, no rush – just small childhood worries, kind friends and always a happy ending.

about.title: Little stories about big feelings
about.p1: Hidden inside an old hollow oak lies Doupátkov, a cosy little village. It is home to Ouško, a curious little rabbit, and his friends. Each episode brings one simple situation that young children know from their own lives – being afraid of the dark, sharing toys, making a new friend or a storm outside the window.
about.p2: The series is slow and soft, in the spirit of classic Czech bedtime cartoons. Nobody spells out the lesson – children discover it on their own, together with Ouško.
about.v1p: Even the night in Doupátkov is blue and kind. No villains, no jump scares before bedtime.
about.v2p: Sharing, jealousy, saying sorry, brushing teeth. Topics your child is going through right now.
about.v3p: Every episode ends with a song by Notička the cricket and the feeling that all is well again.

chars.title: Who lives in Doupátkov
chars.sub: Just a few friends, so even the youngest viewers can easily remember them all.

ousko.name: Ouško
ousko.alt: Ouško the rabbit with a green scarf
ousko.text: He looks at the world with wonder and wants to try everything. Sometimes he makes mistakes, but he always learns something from them.

babca.name: Babča Ježka
babca.alt: Babča Ježka with a headscarf and a lantern
babca.text: She knits in her rocking chair, brews herbal tea and knows what to do when things go wrong. With her lantern, nothing can frighten her.

brumla.name: Brumla
brumla.alt: Brumla the bear cub in green dungarees
brumla.text: A strongman with a big heart. He loves eating, loves sleeping, and at hide-and-seek he hides behind a flower.

cvrcek.name: Notička
cvrcek.alt: Notička the cricket with a violin and a bow tie
cvrcek.text: A cheerful soul who solves everything with a song. His little violin plays at the end of every episode.

liska.name: Ryška
liska.alt: Ryška the fox with a yellow scarf
liska.role: a bit of a rascal fox
liska.text: She notices absolutely everything. She came to Doupátkov as a new friend and teaches the others what is fair.

world.title: A village inside an old oak
world.sub: Round, soft and warm. Ochre, moss green and terracotta – as if the whole forest were knitted from wool.

dub.alt: Brumla and Ouško playing hide-and-seek by the old oak
dub.name: The old oak
dub.text: A hollow tree with little windows, doors and steps. All the friends live inside.

louka.alt: A flowering meadow with a stream
louka.name: Meadow and stream
louka.text: A place for playing, racing and flying kites.

pokojicek.alt: Ouško’s little room with a bed and a candle
pokojicek.name: Ouško’s little room
pokojicek.text: A bed with a patchwork blanket, a candle and a round window looking into the oak’s crown.

svetnicka.alt: Babča’s parlour with a rocking chair and a lantern
svetnicka.name: Babča’s parlour
svetnicka.text: A rocking chair, balls of wool and jars full of herbs.

ep1.title: Ouško Is Afraid of the Dark
ep1.text: Ouško plays with Brumla in the meadow until it gets dark. At home his candle goes out and a huge shadow with long ears appears on the wall. Babča Ježka takes her lantern and goes with him to have a look at the dark. And it turns out that everything has a kind explanation.
ep1.b2: Playing in the meadow, nightfall, the candle goes out
ep1.b3: The shadow is just a coat, the tapping just a twig
ep1.quote: “The dark is just the time when the forest sleeps.”

list.title: 80 little stories
list.sub: Pick a topic your child is dealing with right now, or search for an episode by its title.

parents.title: What an episode looks like
parents.sub: Every episode has the same calm rhythm. Children know what is coming, and that helps them feel safe.

s1.title: Theme song and intro
s1.text: Who, where and what today is about.

s2.title: The story
s2.text: A simple problem the character solves in their own way.

s3.title: The resolution
s3.text: A gentle lesson – never loud, never preachy.

s4.title: The song
s4.text: Notička plays and everyone says goodbye.

parents.tipsTitle: Things to talk about after an episode
tips: What was Ouško afraid of, and what helped him?
Do you ever feel scared too? What makes you feel better?
Who would you give a piece of your strawberry to?
How can you say sorry to a friend?
parents.langsTitle: The series is being made in five languages

notFound.title: Page not found – Doupátkov
notFound.heading: Oops, this little path leads nowhere
notFound.text: Ouško looked everywhere – under the leaves, behind the flowers and down by the stream. But this page isn’t here.
